developer.becomeTitle: Publish your games on Game Hub
developer.becomeIntro: Create a studio to publish your HTML5 games. Games are reviewed by an admin before they appear on the hub.

steps.step1: Create a studio (the developer name players will see).
steps.step2: Create a game: name, description, categories, cover image.
steps.step3: Integrate the Game Hub SDK, zip your build (with index.html) and upload it.
steps.step4: An admin playtests and approves → your game goes live and players climb the leaderboard.

developer.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens – used in URLs, can't be changed later.

api.title: Platform API – run your game on your own domain
api.intro: Your game on its own website can still use Monlabs wallet sign-in, guest play, anti-cheat leaderboards and events – sharing the leaderboard with the hub version.
api.origins: Domains allowed to call the API (one per line)
api.originsHint: Format https://your-domain.com (no path). http only works for localhost during development. Up to 10 domains.
api.newKeyTitle: New key – copy it now, it won't be shown again:
api.newKeyHint: This key is public (safe to put in your game) but only works on the domains above.
api.revokeConfirmText: Games using this key stop working immediately.
api.snippetLogin: wallet sign-in; pass guest: true for guest play
api.newSecretHint: Use the secret key only on your game server (Server API /api/s1). NEVER ship it in browser code – revoke it immediately if it leaks.
api.scoringServer: Only the game server (Server API + secret key)
api.scoringHint: Choose "only the game server" when your backend validates each run: scores sent from the browser are rejected (SERVER_SCORING_ONLY) and your server submits them with POST /api/s1/scores.
api.serverSnippetTitle: Submit scores from your game server
api.serverSnippetComment: Runs on your server (Node.js) – the game gets sessionId from GameHub.gameStart()

usage.title: Platform API usage
usage.chartHint: {metric} per day – hover a bar for details
usage.note: Days are in UTC. Players = distinct accounts that started a play (on the hub and outside it).

webhook.title: Webhook
webhook.intro: Your game server receives a score.submitted event for every new score (JSON POST, HMAC-SHA256 signed in the x-monlabs-signature header). Failed deliveries are retried after 1 min, 5 min, 30 min, 2 h and 12 h.
webhook.urlHint: Must be https and must not point to a private network. Clear it and save to turn the webhook off.
webhook.rotated: Signing secret rotated – the old one no longer works.
webhook.secretTitle: Webhook signing secret – copy it now, it won't be shown again:
webhook.secretHint: Use it on your server to verify signatures (see the "Server API" docs).

adminBoards.title: Leaderboards & events
adminBoards.kindEvent: Event – takes scores from the main board
adminBoards.kindSeparate: Separate board – the game submits to this key
adminBoards.eventHint: Every valid score on the main board during the event also goes into the event board – no game changes needed. Anti-cheat rules follow the main board.
adminBoards.separateHint: The game must call GameHub.gameOver(score, { leaderboard: "{key}" }) for scores to land here.
adminBoards.editHint: Changing times or rules keeps existing scores. Empty time = no limit.
adminBoards.confirmDelete: Delete board "{name}"? It disappears from the game page (scores stay in the database).
adminBoards.hint: Events show on the game page from 14 days before they start until 30 days after they end. No entry fees; prize events need a legal check first.
